usage: filter qc_status == PASS_STRICT for core experiments; PASS_SINGLE_HAND is usable for single-hand work; REVIEW must not be used in core experiments; EXCLUDE is unusable. The dataset files themselves are never modified.

status_definitions.PASS_STRICT: chosen, annotated, robustly triangulated with sufficient geometry, identity confirmed, 2D and 3D consistent
status_definitions.PASS_SINGLE_HAND: this hand is strict-clean but the other hand of the same frame is not
status_definitions.REVIEW: not clearly wrong but not clearly clean; excluded from core work
status_definitions.EXCLUDE: clearly unusable (no annotation, not chosen, confirmed identity swap, or 2D matching no reconstruction)
